entities.summary: The application of tools, techniques, and knowledge to increase agricultural productivity. From the earliest digging sticks and irrigation channels of the Fertile Crescent to the Green Revolution's high-yield varieties and modern precision agriculture, technological innovation in farming has been humanity's most consequential material achievement.
